EdgeFunctionId.description: Edge function slug, name, or hosted function id.
EdgeFunctionId.name: id

data_mode.description: schema-only creates an empty-data branch by dumping schema without table rows. Later saves include table data by default unless include_table_data is explicitly false.

include_table_data.description: When false, creates the branch snapshot with schema only and no table rows. This is incompatible with include_storage_files true.

activate.description: Switch the local runtime to the merged target branch after merge.

autosave.description: When the source branch is active, save it before merging.

target_branch.description: Target branch to update. Currently only main is supported.

include_table_data.description: Defaults true so data added to a schema-only branch is saved normally. Set false only to overwrite the snapshot as schema-only.

protected.description: When true, migrations/up can only run while the active branch is main.

source_db_url.description: Masked when returned by the API.

source_supabase_access_token.description: Masked when returned by the API.

target_db_url.description: Masked when returned by the API.

target_supabase_access_token.description: Masked when returned by the API.

protected.description: Protect this target so migrations/up requires the active branch to be main. Defaults true for prod or production environment labels.

access_token.description: Optional Supabase access token applied to both dev and production unless a side-specific access_token is supplied.

name.description: Sync environment name to create or update.

protected.description: Protect the production target so migrations/up requires the active branch to be main. Defaults true.

reset_user.description: Database user used for destructive reset jobs when this side uses a local Docker container.

access_token.description: Optional Supabase Management API token applied to both sides.

include_storage_objects.description: When true, the plan warns that object bytes must be copied through Storage/S3, not database restore.

container.description: Local Docker database container. Canonical value is supabase-db. Legacy supabase_db_local is normalized to supabase-db by platform-to-local import planning/execution.

type.description: Logical side type, for example platform or local.

limit.description: Apply at most this many pending schema migrations.

sync_storage_buckets.description: Override environment bucket-sync behavior for this job.

details.description: Job-specific metadata useful for detail panes, such as database mode, largest tables, and copy limitations.

phase.description: Machine-readable progress phase for UI state.

progress_events.description: Server-recorded progress history. Use this when the UI needs to show phases that may have happened between polling intervals.

sql.description: The normalized statements joined with blank lines for code-editor display.

statements.description: Normalized executable SQL statements split for display. Flattened Supabase ledger comments are stripped and replay guards such as DROP POLICY IF EXISTS are included.

confirm.description: Required unless dry_run is true. Must be exactly CONFIRM.

schemas.description: Optional schema filters passed to pg_dump/pg_restore.

confirm.description: Required destructive-operation confirmation. Use RESET SOURCE for /reset/source or RESET DESTINATION for /reset/destination.

drop_target_schemas.description: Drop target-owned non-system, non-extension schemas on the side being reset before restoring the source dump. Platform-owned schemas that the connection user cannot drop are preserved and reset with table-data restore when possible.

dry_run.description: Validate what would be reset without changing either side.

prune_edge_functions.description: Delete destination Edge Functions that are not present on the source side.

reset_database.description: Copy all non-system Postgres schemas and data from the opposite side. This includes Supabase auth and storage metadata tables.

reset_edge_functions.description: Mirror Edge Functions from the opposite side when both sides have a local functions directory or Management API project ref configured.

bearerAuth.description: Use SYNC_API_TOKEN as the bearer token.
